Key.English: The arsenal can only be opened on a unit that is inside one of the curator's editing zones. Covers the Arsenal button in a unit's attributes, the context menu's Loadout entry, and the Arsenal module. Copying, pasting and resetting a loadout are not affected. Has no effect until the curator has at least one editing zone.

Healing, repairing, rearming, refueling and skill changes are only possible while the units they would affect are inside one of the curator's editing zones. Sliders stay visible as unit info. Has no effect until the curator has at least one editing zone.
